intent: Independently verify an implementation against its Design Contract and produce Core-owned conformance evidence.
steps: Confirm verifier role is independent from the implementer
Capture each required route/state/viewport on the exact commit SHA
Compare structure, text, components, tokens, accessibility and behavior to the contract
Classify divergences; advisory references never auto-block
Refuse agent-claimed passes when Core recomputation finds blocking defects
invariants: Implementer cannot be the sole verifier
Blocking authoritative divergences prevent acceptance progression
Tolerances come only from the Design Contract
